name: Exp_MAMA
summary: This EA trades based on the MAMA (Mesa Adaptive Moving Average) indicator crossover signals. It opens buy positions when the MAMA fast line crosses above the slow line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing uses a deposit share or fixed lot mechanism via the TradeAlgorithms library.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MAMA（Mesa自适应移动平均线）指标的金叉死叉信号进行交易。当MAMA快线上穿慢线时开多仓，反之开空仓，并配置了止损止盈。仓位管理通过TradeAlgorithms库使用存款比例或固定手数机制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于MESA自适应移动平均线(MAMA)指标的趋势跟踪，通过快线与慢线的交叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当Ma1(快线)从下方穿越Ma2(慢线)时产生买入信号，当Ma1从上方穿越Ma2时产生卖出信号，信号需在指定SignalBar上确认且前一bar方向一致才触发。出场条件包括：固定点数止损(StopLoss_=1000)和止盈(TakeProfit_=2000)，以及反向交叉信号触发的平仓——买入信号时平空头，卖出信号时平多头。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示存款占比。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数实现，支持比例仓位或固定手数两种模式。该策略在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根K线作为信号源，减少了重绘风险但仍存在滞后。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is trend following based on the MESA Adaptive Moving Average (MAMA) indicator, using crossovers between the fast and slow lines to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Ma1 (fast line) crosses above Ma2 (slow line), and a sell signal on the opposite crossover, requiring confirmation on the specified SignalBar with the prior bar showing the opposite relationship. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), plus counter-crossover exits where a buy signal closes shorts and a sell signal closes longs. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share percentages. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen) supporting both proportional and fixed lot modes. The strategy operates on H4 timeframe using SignalBar=1 (previous bar) as the signal source, which reduces repainting risk but introduces inherent lag typical of moving average crossover systems.

pros: MAMA指标具有自适应性，能根据市场波动调整灵敏度，比传统MA更灵活
双向交易许可控制(BuyPosOpen/SellPosClose等)提供了精细的仓位管理灵活性
使用SignalBar=1避免了信号重绘问题，保证回测与实盘一致性
止损止盈参数可配置，提供了基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: MAMA indicator is adaptive, adjusting sensitivity to market volatility, more flexible than traditional MAs
Granular permission controls (BuyPosOpen/SellPosClose etc.) provide flexible position management
Using SignalBar=1 avoids signal repainting, ensuring backtest-to-live consistency
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 趋势跟踪型策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏震荡/趋势市场状态过滤机制，没有ADX或波动率过滤器
没有点差过滤，在某些品种上滑点和点差可能侵蚀利润
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，核心交易逻辑不可见，难以审计风险
cons_en: Trend following strategy prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks market regime filter (no ADX or volatility filter) to distinguish trending from ranging conditions
No spread filter, slippage and spreads can erode profits on certain instruments
Relies on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, making core trading logic opaque and hard to audit
improvements: 添加市场状态过滤器(如ADX或ATR)，在震荡行情中抑制交易信号以减少假信号
增加点差和滑点过滤机制，避免在高点差时段开仓
实现追踪止损功能以锁定趋势利润，而非仅依赖固定止盈
将TradeAlgorithms库的关键函数内联或开源，提高代码透明度和可审计性
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter (e.g., ADX or ATR) to suppress signals during ranging conditions and reduce false entries
Implement spread and slippage filters to avoid opening positions during high-spread periods
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in trend profits rather than relying solely on fixed take profit
Inline or open-source key TradeAlgorithms library functions to improve code transparency and auditability

risk_points: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能连续亏损，缺乏市场状态过滤
止损1000点相对较大，在小账户或高杠杆下可能造成较大回撤
外部TradeAlgorithms库的仓位管理逻辑不可见，存在潜在风险
risk_points_en: Trend following may incur consecutive losses in ranging markets without regime filtering
1000-point stop loss is relatively large, potentially causing significant drawdown on small accounts with high leverage
External TradeAlgorithms library position sizing logic is opaque, introducing potential hidden risk
